faq.q: What is an AI ad image generator?
faq.a: It turns one product photo into a square image for a social post. You add the headline and the price afterward in your ad editor.

faq.q: How do I create an image ad from a photo?
faq.a: Upload the product photo, pick a scene with room for your words, and download the square file. Then build the ad in that app's editor.

faq.q: Where can I use this square file?
faq.a: The download is square, so it fits many social posts. In each ad tool, check that words are not cut off. It does not change size on its own for a tall ad or a wide banner.

faq.q: Can the image include my headline?
faq.a: Yes. Add a short text line on the image, then read it. If a price or a logo looks wrong, type that line in your ad editor before the ad starts.

faq.q: Can I make several versions from one photo?
faq.a: Yes. Make different scenes from the same product photo and compare them before you pick the ad. Each one costs 24 credits, the units your plan spends.
Stores and marketers who already have a product photo and need another square scene without a new shoot.

faq.q: Can I run the image in a live ad?
faq.a: Yes. The file has no watermark, meaning no extra logo on it, and you can use it in your ads. In your ad tool, check that the product is not cut off before the ad starts.

faq.q: Do I have to label the image as AI?
faq.a: Rules differ by app and country. Follow the label your ad account asks you to show. For a more casual photo, see [casual phone-style product photos](page:tpl-ugc).

faq.q: Can a teammate edit the same design?
faq.a: Yes. Share the work, keep logos and colors in one shared place, and leave notes on the design from a computer or a phone.
